closed.detail: At 741d208, syntax check, agent-runtime-no-progress-smoke, and agent-runtime-resilience-smoke all pass. The focused contract proves second duplicate observation blocks before another provider completion while the transient warning remains non-durable.

active.title: P1 Bounded Page Settlement
active.question: Can browser actions wait for a bounded observable transition rather than document.readyState plus fixed wait(100), without over-waiting permanently active pages or weakening protected-target and URL safety?

source_flow.open: createTarget -> _waitReady -> return; _waitReady returns at readyState interactive|complete
source_flow.navigate: Page.navigate -> _waitReady -> return; _waitReady returns at readyState interactive|complete
source_flow.anchor_click: DOM inspection -> Page.navigate -> _waitReady -> one observed state read -> downstreamOutcome UNVERIFIED
source_flow.dom_click: e.click() -> fixed wait(100) -> one observed state read -> downstreamOutcome UNVERIFIED

active.falsifier: A settlement regression must fail at 741d208 because an ordinary DOM click can return before a delayed observable page mutation settles. If the test passes without replacing that fixed-sleep behavior with a bounded transition observable, the regression is not testing the real gap.

proven_findings.detail: 741d208 modifies only src/agent/executive/LiveAgentCore.js (+53/-5) and passes the focused no-progress and neighboring resilience regressions.

At 741d208, _waitReady returns when readyState is interactive or complete. open and navigate use _waitReady. Anchor click uses Page.navigate then _waitReady. Ordinary DOM click executes e.click(), waits exactly 100 ms, performs one URL/title/readyState read, and always reports downstreamOutcome UNVERIFIED.

test/browser-tool-runtime-smoke.js is the existing BrowserToolRuntime behavioral harness. It covers protected transport isolation, URL safety, open/navigate/snapshot/click/type/scroll/close and currently asserts downstreamOutcome UNVERIFIED after click. P1.2 should extend this owner rather than create an independent duplicate browser harness.
Managed Chrome uses a reusable Access-owned profile; task-isolated general browsing remains pending.
Current semantics are DOM-derived; native Chromium AX and screenshot dual perception remain pending.

add: bounded transition settlement observable for post-action DOM/navigation change
DOM quiet window that can terminate without requiring permanent network inactivity
bounded activity/network signal only where it is reliable
settlement metadata in returned browser action evidence
change: replace fixed post-click wait(100) as primary settlement mechanism
strengthen readiness/re-entry beyond document.readyState-only semantics after action

next_acceptance.question: Can the existing BrowserToolRuntime harness prove that a DOM click returning after a fixed 100 ms misses a page mutation that occurs later but still within a bounded settlement window?
next_acceptance.observable: Extend test/browser-tool-runtime-smoke.js with a deterministic delayed post-click mutation/state change greater than 100 ms and assert click does not return until the changed state is observable and settlement is classified as verified/settled.
next_acceptance.falsifier: If the new regression does not fail on 741d208 specifically because click returned before the delayed mutation/state change, it does not establish the settlement gap and no source patch is authorized.
